sections.h2: Corn ethanol's CORSIA default (90.8–100.6 gCO₂e/MJ) sits above the 89 baseline

chart.title: On the certified default, maize ethanol fails before the 10% cut applies

sections.means: A simplified calculator's maize value of 43 gCO₂e/MJ passes, while CORSIA's own default table puts maize ethanol above the baseline.
sections.todo: Check any maize-ethanol SAF claim against the 8th-edition ICAO table or an approved body's actual-value calculation, not a generic calculator value.

sections.h2: Molasses passes CORSIA only through the isobutanol route India does not use

chart.title: Molasses has a default only on the isobutanol route, not the ethanol route India uses

sections.means: Molasses has a default of 34.3–36.1 gCO₂e/MJ only on the isobutanol route, and no default at all on the ethanol route India uses.
sections.todo: An Indian molasses-to-ethanol-to-jet producer needs a full actual-value lifecycle calculation through an approved certification body.

sections.h2: Only 6% of India's used cooking oil is collected, the feedstock SAF uses today

chart.title: 94% of India's used cooking oil goes uncollected, the feedstock SAF can use today
chart.sub: Share of estimated used cooking oil, %.
chart.source: SAF Association reporting, Sept 2026, via Tribune India/ANI.

sections.means: India generates an estimated 1.8–2.6 million tonnes of used cooking oil a year, and only 110,000–156,000 tonnes is collected.
sections.todo: Build collection before capacity, since the 5%-by-2030 target needs roughly 0.4–0.5 million tonnes of SAF a year.

sections.h2: India's SAF targets reach only 5% by 2030, and cover international flights only

chart.title: India's indicative SAF target reaches 5% by 2030, where Japan targets 10%
chart.sub: Indicative SAF targets, %. India's apply to international flights only.
chart.source: PIB 1979705; parliamentary statement as reported in trade press. Japan figure as stated in the post.

sections.means: India's indicative targets are 1%, 2% and 5% for 2027, 2028 and 2030, and cover international flights only.
sections.todo: Notify a domestic-flight SAF mandate, which India has not yet issued.
